def fetch_all_text(phone_number):
    raw=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res=apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=token, phone_number=phone_number, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        raw.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    return raw

def fetch_all_voice(phone_number):
    raw=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res=apis.phone.search_voice_messages(access_token=token, phone_number=phone_number, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        raw.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    return raw
